comments.author: Alrn
comments.body:
Obtained simply by visiting Great Pyramid of Giza legacy site, which can be only done so by reaching The Great Pyramid of Giza's Past, middle / center section of Ancient Civilization in the Desert legacy. Works great for searching the yellow pillar spots in there, but i can't really confirm if this works for digging gold nuggets or gemstones.

Also it's on the list of the new Memorial Album Prosperity of Ancient Egypt
